findings.title: FilterView drops the `key` prop from the mapped GrafanaRuleListItem
findings.description: The hunk removes `key={key}` from the `<GrafanaRuleLoader>` element and the replacement `<GrafanaRuleListItem>` does not set a key. This element is rendered inside a list map, so React will warn about missing keys and may reuse or misplace list item state when results change. The `key` variable was in scope before the change and should be kept on the new element.

findings.title: Test name promises action menu options but the test only checks the More button
findings.description: The test titled "should render More button with action menu options" only asserts that the More button exists and has the right aria-label and text. It never opens the menu or checks any action items. The name and the assertions do not match. Rename the test, or open the menu and assert the options as the later test does.

findings.title: Edit button href expectation does not match the encoded identifier used by RuleActionsButtons
findings.description: The test "should render multiple rules with their own action buttons" expects the edit href to contain `/alerting/${uid}/edit`. The unchanged `editURL` line in RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx builds the path from `encodeURIComponent(ruleId.stringifyIdentifier(identifier))`. If that string includes a source prefix, the encoded path will not contain `/alerting/<uid>/edit`, and the assertion will fail. Confirm the output of `stringifyIdentifier` for a Grafana identifier and align the expected string.

findings.title: Prometheus rule is passed to UnknownRuleListItem's `ruleDefinition`, which previously received a ruler rule
findings.description: The fallback `return <UnknownRuleListItem ... ruleDefinition={rule} />` now passes a `GrafanaPromRuleDTO`. The previous code passed `rulerRule`. If `UnknownRuleListItem` types `ruleDefinition` as `RulerRuleDTO`, this is a type error. If it is typed loosely, the component now receives a different shape than before. Check the prop type and the component's use of that value.
